name: Field Boundary Improver
tagline: CDL rotation splits FTW boundaries where two fields act like one. BETA.
description: Uses 8 years of USDA Cropland Data Layer (CDL) rotation history to find FTW global field boundaries that under-segment — two fields with genuinely different crop rotations lumped into one polygon. 71 McLean County IL fields reviewed: 56 splits found, 10 kept as-is, 5 flagged for geometry check. Splits are snapped to the PLSS cardinal grid. Viewer shows the FTW original vs the refined split on satellite, with the rotation-divergence signal that placed the boundary. Data-quality signal, not a production boundary layer.
licenseNote: Tile code MIT. FTW boundaries: CC-BY-4.0 (Regrow Ag / World Resources Institute). CDL: USDA NASS public domain.
